title: Other Output
text: Write to one or more output channels not handled by specific blocks, 1 input, 1 output; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Output channels} sets the channel vector that selects other output, {Optional parameters} sets the optional parameters that the driver, {Initial value} sets the value that the channel generates before execution starts and {Final value} sets the value that the channel generates after execution ends. Values come from the instance.
